title: Monodromy Eigenvalues of Milnor Fibers for Line Arrangements
summary: It is an important problem to know whether the monodromy on the cohomology of Milnor fibers associated to hyperplane arrangements is a combinatorial invariant. In this paper, we obtain a combinatorial vanishing criterion for certain eigenspaces of this algebraic monodromy in line arrangements. Combining with Hirzebruch inequality, which is a consequence of Bogomolov--Miyaoka--Yau inequality, we prove that for essential complex line arrangements, the eigenvalues of the monodromy have orders at most five.
